items.title: Commit the restructure + import the backlog to GitHub: `python3 scripts/github/bootstrap_issues.py` in the repo
First commit + push boxcanyon to GitHub (private)
Week 0 reading: K&R §2.6.1, §3.2, §3.3; Gaffer "UDP vs TCP", "Sending and Receiving Packets", "Virtual Connection over UDP"; Gambetta pt 1
M1 readiness: exercises E1–E5 + answer 11 self-check questions, then sign off (repo: docs/learning/M1-readiness.md)
Ask Dr. Skiles: is C# OK for CMS 270? Can one codebase count for both classes? Any required OOD artifacts?
WP0d: review/approve the M1 class design (repo: docs/OOD.md §3)
Build M1 server + client + serializer tests (spec: docs/milestones/M1-udp.md)
M1 evidence screenshots (run, Wireshark lo0, nc garbage test) + pitch + reflection
Week 1–2 reading: K&R §2.6.2, §3.4, §3.5, §2.2.7, §3.8; Gaffer "Reliability and Congestion Avoidance"
Agent: Godot greybox canyon + FPS controller (single-player)
Build M2 TCP session + graceful disconnect (docs/milestones/M2-tcp.md)
Accept ADR-0004 (sync) + ADR-0006 (concurrency) after Gambetta 2–4, Fix Your Timestep, Snapshot Interpolation, Source Networking
First two-machine test on home LAN (not campus Wi-Fi)
Decide on host migration stretch; email Dr. Skiles if yes
M3 freeze: bot audit, two-machine recording, reflection
Record final demo video + half-page summary
